definition: Party level of a group of player characters: the mean of the PC levels received, rounded to the nearest integer, with .5 rounding up. Each level is an integer from 1 to 20; any other value is outside this Concept. With n ≥ 1 levels of sum s, level = (2·s + n) / (2·n) in integer division, with no floating point anywhere; the result is always between 1 and 20. pcCount = n, each PC counted once. The result does not depend on the order of the levels. With n = 0, decided before any division, level is null and pcCount is 0: never 0 or 1, and not an error. The Concept receives the levels already selected; choosing which PCs count is not part of it, and it never filters. model is always "v1"; asOf is the dataVersion the levels were read at.

level.description: Round-half-up of the mean of the levels received; null if and only if pcCount is 0.

model.description: Version of this Concept; always equals the concept version.

asOf.description: The dataVersion the levels were read at; present on every result, including an empty list.
